description: Valkey-owned expedition and active-enemy buffers with revision-checked combat continuation, immutable terminal settlement snapshots, movement admission, run-qualified cleanup and SQL reward/history settlement (C1, C2).

lock_sequence.note: Lock all participating expedition member characters in ascending ID order before claiming the run and applying rewards.

lock_sequence.mode: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via shared post-battle settlement

lock_sequence.note: Escape only: clears each member's meal flag after the character and inventory writes.

transaction_boundaries.note: The run-ID history INSERT claims settlement once after the character lock; record updates and owner/run-qualified SQL fallback deletion share that transaction. Live-store/member cleanup runs separately after commit.
